- The player can only move within a certain "zone" or "room"
- Moving outside the zone triggers a reset
- The zone changes after each reset
Looking at the reset destinations:
- [26, 30], [26, 36], [26, 24], [35, 39], [38, 24], [38, 33], [29, 30], [26, 30]

- Bottom-right: rows 37-42, cols 32-40

- RIGHT x 3 → col 27 (row 26, still in top-left quadrant)
- DOWN x 3 → row 29 (col 27, still in top-left quadrant)
- SPACE

This contradicts the hypothesis, because [26, 33] and [29, 33] are in the top-right quadrant, not the top-left quadrant. So the player was in the top-right quadrant and moved within it, but still triggered a reset when pressing SPACE.
Wait, but the reset happened after pressing SPACE, not after moving. So maybe SPACE triggers a reset when the player is not on a block or marker?
Let me re-examine the SPACE effects:
1. SPACE on gray block: gray→green, blue→green, no reset
2. SPACE on charcoal block: no color change, no reset, player moved
3. SPACE at [38, 33] (not on block): player moved right 6, no reset
4. SPACE at [26, 36] (not on block): gray→green, blue→green, no reset
5. SPACE at [29, 33] (on magenta marker): reset
So SPACE on a magenta marker causes a reset. SPACE on a block or near a block converts colors or moves the player. SPACE in other positions may have other effects.
Let me try pressing SPACE at [26, 24] to see what happens.
